- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next 5–7 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model often underestimates; add 1–2% to forecast for next 5–7 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 3% from prior peak), model frequently overshoots; cap forecast at 10–15% below peak for next 3–5 days.  
- If 3+ consecutive days of downward sentiment or price decline, model underreacts; adjust forecast to reflect mean reversion toward 10–15-day moving average.  
- For 30-day horizon, model consistently overpredicts in high-sentiment periods; apply 2–4% downward bias if sentiment > 0.67 over last 5 days.  
- If sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67) and price is trending, model often fails to capture momentum; use sentiment-weighted average of recent 5-day trend for correction.
